title: Worktop Compare:
a 3D price calculator
that sends better leads
slides.subtitle: Built with Claude in a month. An earlier version generated £7m worth of leads in 11 months.

slides.label: Six steps from idea to price
slides.caption: Stone, brand, colour, dimensions, extras, details. Real swatches for every stone.

slides.label: The old lead
slides.detail: "How much for a quartz worktop?" and nothing else. Someone then chases the sizes, material, colour and edges before they know if the job is real.
slides.start: Count how many emails it takes you to get the details for one quote.

slides.label: A live 3D preview
slides.detail: As the homeowner types their measurements, a 3D model of their own layout builds on screen. Drag to rotate, zoom in, watch it update with every number.
slides.start: Seeing their own job is what keeps people going to the end.

slides.label: The new lead
slides.detail: Stone, brand, colour, every measurement, edge profile and extras, captured up front. And the homeowner has already seen an estimated price.
slides.start: List the questions you always chase. Those become your steps.

slides.label: Matched on fit
slides.detail: Each enquiry goes to up to 5 local fabricators, matched on postcode coverage and the stone they work with. Fabricators are vetted for workmanship, insurance and reliability.
slides.start: Send each lead only to someone who can actually do the job.

slides.label: Why AI changed this
slides.detail: Sketchfab puts a custom 3D configurator at $15,000 to $50,000. We built the whole platform, 3D included, in one month with Claude, Lovable, Supabase, Apify and ChatGPT.
slides.start: Polished, interactive UI is no longer an agency-only budget line.

slides.label: What the earlier version did
slides.detail: The calculator we built before this one, for a client, generated £7m worth of leads in 11 months. That is lead value, not sales, and your results will differ.
slides.start: Answer "how much would it be?" instantly, and answer it well.

title: Better leads.
Built in a month.
slides.body: Worktop Compare is not live yet. Any business that quotes made-to-measure work could use the same idea.
slides.cta: What do you always have to chase before you can quote? Tell us in the comments.
